world.location: THE DINOSAUR AGE, AFTER THE METEOR (day 18): O.draw_dino_world(cr, t, DX-6000, DX+9000, pre=1.0, after=1.0, volcano=(DX+900, 1100, 0.0), ferns=FERNS, cycads=CYCADS, cave=CAVE) with DX=2000000, CAVE=DX+3600 (the little cave rock), the smashed log at DX+1700; brown ash sky, flattened ferns, smoking craters, ash falling (O.draw_ash overlay). He stands at centre CAVE-850 (body offset CAVE-1390). S.floor=False. See ltcd/episodes/ep018. Next comment episode: he leaves to the right into a new world.
companions: none (the T. rex stomped off into the ash - day 18)
left behind in Mordor (never going back): the giant eagle
props: left behind in his house (never going back): the TV + console + controller, the sink of dishes
the umbrella is GONE (burnt to a skeleton by the meteor, crumbled - day 18)
left behind on the beach: the yellow smiley kite
left behind in the town: the CAT RESCUE SHELTER he built
far behind (never going back): the park, the beach, the black car, the WHITE PARTY mansion, MEGAPLEX 30, FUN PARK, the town, Mordor, green hill, the airfield, the burger place
traits: beat the block game on hardcore with half a heart (day 4)
ate a billion burgers, which launched him into space on a cartoon poop jet; belly deflated back to a stick (day 5)

rocked a mom's baby to sleep and fell asleep holding it; she kissed him on the cheek and he blushed (day 6). The mom (O.draw_mom: long brown hair + bun, pink dress) shops at the burger place - callback possible

EXPELLED FOREVER from wizard school (day 7): read his acceptance letter, sprinted into the 9 3/4 wall and bounced off, used the door in the wall instead, the giant talking hat found no brain in his head (hello... echoed) and blasted him into the empty white room

flew a plane (day 8): took off from the FLIGHT SCHOOL airfield, looped until he went green, climbed out of the atmosphere into space, puked a zero-g blob (back to normal), fell back down on fire and planted the plane nose-first in the field; the flaming puke landed next to him. He looks completely normal again (no soot, no tint).

went to green hill (day 9): collected rings deadpan, ran until his legs were a blur wheel, ran a giant loop, RINGS 999, blasted past the GOAL sign and skidded to a stop; victory stance with a peace sign; the most harmless little ladybug robot puttered up, poked him and knocked him flat on his back; every ring burst out of him (RINGS 0). Looks normal.

took the ring to mordor (day 10, re-cut 2): snatched the last ring on green hill, ran to the black gate (ONE DOES NOT SIMPLY WALK INTO MORDOR), whistled up a giant eagle; when the eye's searchlight closed in he put the ring on and went invisible, so the beam locked on the eagle carrying a floating ring, and the eagle dropped him into the volcano; he dropped the ring into the lava and nearly went in after it (speed-game reflex), it melted; the eye blew up, the tower fell, the volcano fired him out into the rubble; the eagle showed up after it was all over. He lives in Mordor now. Looks normal.

built a CAT RESCUE SHELTER and was happy about it (day 11, re-cut): ran out of Mordor into a sunny town, found a black kitten in a FREE KITTEN box (slow blinks), built the shelter, rescued a cat from a tree and a line of kittens, fed them (one can - every head turned), they chose the box over the fancy bed, a cat pushed his mug off the shelf (he caught it), on adoption day the mom from day 6 adopted the orange cat, he stamped ADOPTED on every photo - the last was the kitten's, so he adopted it. Real smile. It rides on his head now. Looks normal.

took his cat to the theme park (day 12): ran from the town into FUN PARK; teacups - the kitten batted the wheel until it spun crazy fast and he laughed for real, then dizzy; YOU MUST BE THIS TALL - short by a hair until the kitten sat up on his head (DING); THE BIG ONE coaster: lift hill, hang at the top, the kitten's slow blink gave him the nerve, arms up (despite KEEP ARMS AND LEGS INSIDE), drop, two loops, airtime, FLASH; the RIDE PHOTO shows him screaming with joy and the kitten bored. Looks normal.

went to the movies (day 13): ran out of FUN PARK's back gate (BYE NOW!) to MEGAPLEX 30 (EXPLOSION 7, TONIGHT ONLY); NO PETS - he put a tiny cowboy hat on the kitten and the usher stared him down but let it slide; SMALL popcorn $47.50, taller than him; the card reader asked for a tip and he pressed 30% ($61.75) under the cashier's stare; in an empty theater a giant in a top hat sat right in front of him (leaning didn't help); 47 previews, ate all the popcorn before the movie; pulled out a periscope and watched EXPLOSION 7 over the hat (car, building blows up, car jumps the fireball); the tall guy got up and left at THE END. Looks normal.

went to the white party (day 14): a black car took him up an endless driveway to a mansion; the doors opened by themselves; passed the ALL WHITE dress code by being a white stick figure; ate one canape; the host (white suit, shades, gold chain) tapped him on the shoulder, staredown, pulled out a bottle of baby oil and chased him through the west wing doors; he slid under the champagne table, the host wiped out into the champagne tower; he escaped into the car; the party favor was a tiny baby oil, tossed out the window. Looks normal.

was told to be happy (day 15, 'Seja feliz'): the black car dropped him at a sunny beach and left; he couldn't smile, a finger smile flopped, a seagull stole his whole ice-cream cone, a little rain cloud appeared over his head and followed him, lightning hit the sand next to him; he sat in the rain; the cloud's gust gave him the idea of a kite; it yanked him up through the cloud into the sun - he laughed for real, looped; the abandoned cloud rained out into a rainbow, the wind died, he slid down the rainbow and landed in the sand; the seagull dropped the same cone back, he caught it and ate it. Huge real grin. Looks normal.

got a girlfriend and had a baby - and lost them (day 17, alt cut): ran off the beach into a park; she walked past his rose; the spaghetti kiss; the stork made him SIGN HERE and dropped the baby in his lap; montage: SOLD sign, slow dance, fridge photo, couch cuddle; record scratch; he gamed while she bounced the crying baby; he put one more plate on the tower of dishes; she vacuumed in front of his game and the cord unplugged the TV; he snuck in at 3 AM and she clicked on the lamp; the argument; WE NEED TO TALK; she left with the baby, then came back for the couch. He shrugged and sat down on the floor to play video games. Looks normal.

woke up in the dinosaur age (day 18): yawned, left his house, fell asleep under a tree in a meadow; time ran backwards around him (the tree un-grew, giant ferns, a volcano); T. rex footsteps rippled the puddle; it sniffed him, he froze, his curl boinged, ROAR; chase (hurdled a log it then smashed), hid in a little cave - its tiny arms couldn't reach; the meteor came; he pulled out a tiny umbrella and the T. rex squeezed its head under it; impact - both fine, the umbrella burnt to a skeleton and crumbled; a tiny-arm high five (he had to jump); it stomped off. Looks normal.
world.notes: Justin, 2026-11-08: NO recurring characters - it's just him. Write any new people out by the end of the episode. Every episode moves on to a new world.

Wake up in the dinosaurs age
